If you wish to contact us about any aspect of our site, about shorebirds, or are interested in joining and helping, with our work please get in touch using the following contact details.

You don’t need any specialist skills to become involved in Queensland Wader Study Group and your contribution to our projects can be as much or as little as you want. Just being a member helps us as a group in our objectives and if your interested in birdwatching, counting waders, helping with banding or reading leg flags hopefully we’ve something to offer you.
